links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy and confidence score of DSM-5-grounded evidence-guided prompting versus direct and CoT prompting
links.effect: On OpenBioLLM, EGDR raised accuracy from 0.31 (Direct) to 0.76 and DCS from 0.50 to 0.67. On MedLlama, DCS rose from 0.58 (CoT) to 0.77. Overall gains were up to +45% accuracy and +36% DCS.
links.quote: For instance, on OpenBioLLM, EGDR improves accuracy from 0.31 (Direct) to 0.76 and increases DCS from 0.50 to 0.67.

unlisted_practices: Evidence-guided diagnostic reasoning prompts that interleave evidence extraction with logical reasoning based on DSM-5 criteria
Diagnosis confidence scoring using a Knowledge Attribution Score and a Logic Consistency Score

screen.reason: Evaluates prompting/guardrail frameworks (Evidence-Guided Diagnostic Reasoning grounded in DSM-5 and Diagnosis Confidence Scoring) applied to existing LLMs on a diagnostic dataset.

primary.practice: evidence-guided diagnostic reasoning prompting and confidence scoring
